sentence: Press too hard and the soft tip of a ____ will splay into a fuzzy brush, so the lettering tutor tells every beginner to keep a light hand.
meaning: 笔尖由多孔纤维制成的毡头笔
note: splay into a fuzzy brush 说的是纤维笔尖受压散开；ballpoint 靠小滚珠出墨，fountain 是金属笔尖，gel 也是走珠式笔尖，三者压了都不会分叉变形。

sentence: To make the colour-coded timeline legible from the back of the lecture hall, Maya swapped her usual pencil for a ____ and produced wide, even strokes on the poster.
meaning: 能画出较宽笔画的毡头纤维笔
note: wide, even strokes 要靠毡头笔的粗纤维尖；ballpoint 与 gel 出的是细线，fountain 的金属笔尖墨色随压力变化，都画不出海报式均匀宽笔画。

sentence: Impressed by how calmly the intern handled the angry customer, the manager offered her a permanent contract ____, without even consulting the human resources department.
meaning: 当场，立即，没有拖延地
note: without even consulting HR 说明决定是当场作出的；on the dot 指准时守点，on the way 指在路上，on the whole 指总体而言，都不表示立即做决定。

sentence: Asked to say a few words at the alumni dinner, Professor Lin ____ recalled a story about the dormitory, which surprised students who had assumed he had prepared a careful script.
meaning: 当场即兴地，事前无准备
note: 同学们以为他准备了讲稿，与 prepared a careful script 形成反差，说明故事是当场即兴讲的；on the dot 是准时，on the way 是在路上，on the whole 是总体上。

sentence: Before signing a lease, first-year students are advised to ____ the fare home at the end of term, since the tickets alone can swallow a month's allowance.
meaning: 把…计算在内，考虑进去
note: since 从句说车票能吃掉一个月生活费，所以要把它算进预算；factor out 恰相反，是把某因素排除在计算外；trade in 指旧物折价换新；phase in 指新措施分阶段推行。

sentence: The extra traffic that the new bypass would bring had not been ____ when the junction was designed, so queues now stretch half a mile at peak times.
meaning: 被计算在内，被考虑进去
note: so 从句说高峰时段车流排出半英里，可见设计路口时没把绕城路带来的额外车流算进去；factored out 意为不计入，与拥堵的结果矛盾；traded in 是以旧换新，phased in 是分阶段实施。

sentence: Because the professor rarely checks attendance, most of the class ____ skip the eight o'clock sessions and revise from the slides instead.
meaning: 倾向于，往往会做某事
note: 前半句给出「很少点名」这一诱因，instead 又说明学生自己选择看课件；were obliged to 是被迫，were entitled to 是有权享有，were expected to 是被期待，都不表示自身倾向。

sentence: Shy students ____ keep quiet in seminars unless the tutor calls on them by name, so many departments now assign rotating speaking roles.
meaning: 倾向于，容易做某事
note: so 从句说各系要安排轮流发言，正因为害羞的学生习惯性沉默；are reluctant to keep quiet 意为不愿沉默，与 shy 矛盾；are about to 表示即将发生，与长期的性格倾向不符；are entitled to 表有权，不解释各系为何要安排轮流发言。

sentence: On Friday afternoons the chess club members usually ____ in the student union café, arguing about openings over cheap coffee until the cleaners arrive.
meaning: 与朋友一起闲逛、消磨时间
note: arguing until the cleaners arrive 写一群人消磨整个下午；hang up 是挂断电话或挂起衣物，hang on 是稍等或抓紧，hang back 是迟疑不前，都不能与 café 搭配表示聚会。

sentence: Instead of heading home after the lab, the three of them ____ at the night market for hours, tasting skewers and bargaining over phone cases.
meaning: 结伴闲逛，一起打发时间
note: for hours 加 tasting、bargaining 写几个人在夜市消磨时间；hung up 是挂断，hung on 是抓住不放或稍等，hung back 是畏缩落后，都不表示结伴闲逛。

sentence: With the club's founder graduating in June, everyone wondered who would be ____ when the new season began and the membership drive started.
meaning: 掌舵，处于领导主管的位置
note: 创办人毕业引出「谁来接手主持大局」的问题；in the dark 指不知情，on the spot 指到现场或当场，under the weather 指身体不适，都不能表示担任负责人。

sentence: Throughout the three-week crossing it was the captain's daughter who stood ____, steering past rocks in the fog while the crew mended nets below deck.
meaning: 掌舵，站在舵轮旁驾驶船只
note: steering past rocks 说明她在操舵；at the bow 是船头，at the stern 是船尾，at the dock 是码头，都只是船上或岸边的位置，不含驾驶之意。

sentence: At first the committee was sceptical, but after a single trial week everyone ____ the plan and voted to fund it for a full year.
meaning: 被…吸引，对…产生好感
note: but 与 voted to fund 表明态度由怀疑转为喜欢；was put off 是被打消兴趣，与拨款矛盾；was taken for 后接表身份的名词，意为被误认为；was taken in 是被骗。

sentence: The admissions tutor ____ the candidate's portfolio the moment she opened it, and later admitted that the sketches had decided the interview before it began.
meaning: 被…吸引，一看就很欣赏
note: 后半句说素描在面试开始前就定了结果，说明导师一看作品集就喜欢；was taken aback 表吃惊且须与 by 连用；was taken over 是被接管，was taken up 是被占用或开始从事。

sentence: After a decade of selling only second-hand paperbacks, the family bookshop ____ last spring, adding stationery, board games and a tiny gallery to its crowded shelves.
meaning: 拓展业务，向新的领域发展
note: adding stationery and board games 说明书店在旧书之外增加了新品类；branched off 指道路或管道分岔；broke out 指战争、火灾爆发；brought out 须接产品作宾语，意为推出。

sentence: Now that the children have left home, she plans to ____ into pottery, something she has wanted to try since her own school days.
meaning: 拓展业务，涉足新的经营领域
note: branch out into 指在原有领域之外开拓新方向，此处指开始一项新爱好；branch off 指道路、线路分岔；carry out 后直接接计划、任务作宾语；phase out 指逐步淘汰。

sentence: Although they grew up in different provinces, the two roommates soon discovered that they ____, from a taste for spicy noodles to a habit of studying after midnight.
meaning: 有很多共同之处，趣味相投
note: from ... to ... 列举两人相同的口味与作息，正是共同点；had a lot to offer 指能提供很多，had a lot in store 指将来会有很多事，had a lot at stake 指利害攸关。

sentence: Before matching each mentor with a first-year student, the programme compares their hobbies and reading habits, on the theory that pairs who ____ will talk more freely.
meaning: 有较多共同点，合得来
note: 把两人的爱好和阅读习惯拿来比对，说明要挑的是有共同点的一对；have much to offer 指能贡献很多，have much in store 指将来会有很多，have much at stake 指利害重大，都不表示彼此相近。

sentence: Since my first lecture is not until eleven, I usually ____ on weekday mornings, while my roommate, who has a nine o'clock lab, is already out the door.
meaning: 睡懒觉，早上故意多睡一会儿
note: 前句说第一节课十一点才开始，与九点就得出门的室友形成对比，说明自己上午赖床晚起；sleep off 后接头痛、疲劳，意为睡一觉消除；sleep on 后接待议之事，意为暂缓决定；sleep over 指在别人家过夜。

sentence: We had planned to hike at dawn, but after the long flight everyone ____ instead, and we only reached the trailhead after lunch.
meaning: 睡懒觉，睡过了原定时间
note: but 与 after lunch 说明黎明出发的计划落空，大家起晚了；slept off 须接疲劳、头痛等宾语；slept on 须接待议之事，意为改日再定；slept over 指在别人家过夜。

sentence: Students may ____ as many as ten books at once, provided that nothing overdue is still on their account.
meaning: 从图书馆办理借出手续
note: nothing overdue on their account 是借书时系统设的条件，说明这里讲借出；check in 在图书馆语境指还书，方向正好相反；check up 多与 on 连用表核查，check off 是逐项打勾。

sentence: Before the contract was signed, the club treasurer insisted on ____ each clause with a lawyer, and that caution later saved the society nearly two thousand yuan.
meaning: 仔细查看，逐条核对内容
note: 省下两千元说明她逐条核查过合同条款；checking off 只是逐项打勾，查不出问题；checking in 是报到入住；checking up 须与 on 连用才成立。

sentence: ____ why the heating kept shutting down at night took the maintenance crew almost two days; the culprit was a timer wired to the wrong circuit.
meaning: 查明原因，弄明白其中缘由
note: why 从句作宾语，只有 figure out 能接疑问从句表示找出原因；figure in 是动宾结构，须接具体项目；figure on 后接名词或动名词，意为指望；turn out 不接 why 从句。

sentence: Rather than guess at the total, the treasurer sat down with a pencil and ____ exactly how much each member still owed after the trip.
meaning: 算出总数，用笔计算出来
note: Rather than guess 要求与「猜」相反的「算出来」，exactly how much 正是它的宾语；figured in 指把某项算进去，须接具体项目；figured on 意为指望；turned out 意为结果是。

sentence: With forty applications on her desk, the coach used fitness tests and short interviews to ____ the list to six finalists before the final trial.
meaning: 缩小范围，把名单减到
note: 四十份申请只留六人，是从多到少压缩名单；tone down 指语气或颜色缓和，water down 指削弱内容、稀释，slow down 指放慢速度，都接不了 the list to six。

sentence: Thanks to a neighbour's security camera, the time of the break-in ____ to a twenty-minute window before the detectives had even arrived.
meaning: 被缩小范围，被缩减到
note: narrow down 指把范围收窄；这里把作案时间压缩到二十分钟的区间；was toned down 指被缓和，was watered down 指被削弱，was slowed down 指被放慢，都不能表示范围缩到某个区间。
